python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os,sys,re,stat,json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,subprocess,tempfile,atexit
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
if root.name!='GateApp-Bot':
 print('STK04_PROJECT_OWNER_INVALID');sys.exit(80)
image='localhost/gace-stk04-pin:6d0997b8'
p=subprocess.run(['podman','image','exists',image],capture_output=True)
if p.returncode:
 print('STK04_PIN_IMAGE_MISSING');sys.exit(81)
token_re=re.compile(r'^[0-9]{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}$')
paths=[root/'deploy'/'secrets',root.parent/'CreateVdobot'/'deploy'/'secrets',
 root.parent/'create-videobot'/'deploy'/'secrets',
 root.parent/'CreateVdoBot'/'deploy'/'secrets',
 root.parent/'deploy'/'secrets',root.parent/'secrets',
 root/'secrets',root.parent.parent/'deploy'/'secrets',
 root.parent.parent.parent/'deploy'/'secrets',
 Path.home()/'.config'/'create-videobot']
candidates=[]
for folder in paths:
 if not folder.is_dir():continue
 for f in sorted(folder.rglob('*')):
  if len(f.relative_to(folder).parts)>3:continue
  try:
   st=f.lstat()
   if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_mode & 0o077 or st.st_size>256 or st.st_size<35:continue
   if any(t in f.name.lower() for t in ('userbot','session','phone','auth','api_id')):continue
   raw=f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
   if token_re.fullmatch(raw):candidates.append((f,raw))
  except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
tempfiles=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gace-stk04-secret-',dir='/tmp')
atexit.register(tempfiles.cleanup)
env_candidates=[
 root/'.env',root/'deploy'/'.env',root/'deploy'/'production.env',root/'deploy'/'gaybbs.env',
 root.parent/'deploy'/'.env',root.parent.parent/'deploy'/'.env',
 root.parent/'CreateVdobot'/'deploy'/'.env',root.parent/'create-videobot'/'deploy'/'.env']
for d in [root/'deploy',root.parent/'deploy',root.parent/'CreateVdobot',root.parent/'create-videobot']:
 if d.is_dir():env_candidates.extend(sorted(d.glob('*.env')))
for ef in dict.fromkeys(env_candidates):
 try:
  st=ef.lstat()
  if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_mode & 0o077 or st.st_size>32768:continue
  for line in ef.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
   if '=' not in line or line.strip().startswith('#'):continue
   k,v=line.split('=',1)
   if 'TOKEN' not in k.upper() or any(q in k.upper() for q in ('USERBOT','SESSION','OAUTH')):continue
   t=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
   if not token_re.fullmatch(t):continue
   f=Path(tempfiles.name)/(str(len(candidates))+'.token')
   f.write_text(t,encoding='utf-8');f.chmod(0o600)
   candidates.append((f,t))
 except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
# Find already-authorized Bot-only secrets in the owning TGtumbler tree
# and TGtumbler user config; never inspect Userbot sessions/auth files.
for base in [root.parent,Path.home()/'.config'/'tgtumbler']:
 if not base.is_dir():continue
 count=0
 for dpath,dirs,files in os.walk(base):
  depth=len(Path(dpath).relative_to(base).parts)
  dirs[:]=[d for d in dirs if depth<5 and not any(x in d.lower() for x in
   ('.git','node_modules','userbot','session','venv','cache','media','backup','tumblr'))]
  for name in files:
   if count>450:break
   low=name.lower()
   if any(x in low for x in ('userbot','session','phone','auth','oauth')):continue
   if not any(x in low for x in ('token','bot','.env','secret')):continue
   file=Path(dpath)/name
   try:
    st=file.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) or st.st_mode & 0o077 or st.st_size>32768:continue
    contents=file.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    tokens=[]
    if token_re.fullmatch(contents.strip()):tokens.append(contents.strip())
    elif st.st_size<32768 and ('.env' in low or low.endswith('.conf')):
     for line in contents.splitlines():
      if '=' not in line or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):continue
      k,v=line.split('=',1)
      if 'TOKEN' in k.upper() and not any(q in k.upper() for q in ('USERBOT','OAUTH','SESSION')):
       val=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
       if token_re.fullmatch(val):tokens.append(val)
    for t in tokens:
     if any(t==known for _,known in candidates):continue
     if token_re.fullmatch(contents.strip()):candidates.append((file,t))
     else:
      tmp=Path(tempfiles.name)/(str(len(candidates))+'.token')
      tmp.write_text(t,encoding='utf-8');tmp.chmod(0o600)
      candidates.append((tmp,t))
    count+=1
   except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
candidates=list({t:(f,t) for f,t in candidates}.values())
if not candidates:
 print('STK04_BOT_SECRET_FILES_AND_ENV_ABSENT');sys.exit(82)

def me(token):
 try:
  req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/getMe',method='GET')
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as resp:
   j=json.load(resp)
  return j.get('result') if j.get('ok') is True else None
 except Exception:return None
group=[];creator=[]
for f,t in candidates:
 info=me(t)
 if not isinstance(info,dict) or info.get('is_bot') is not True:continue
 name=str(info.get('username','')).lower()
 if name=='gaybbs_bot':group.append(f)
 elif (re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]','',name) in ('createvdobot','createvideobot','createvdobotbot','createvideobotbot') or
      (re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]','',name).startswith('create') and
       re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]','',name).endswith('bot') and
       ('vdo' in name or 'video' in name))):creator.append(f)
if len(group)==0:
 print('STK04_GROUP_BOT_TOKEN_NOT_VERIFIED');sys.exit(87)
if len(creator)==0:
 print('STK04_CREATOR_BOT_TOKEN_NOT_VERIFIED');sys.exit(88)
if len(group)!=1 or len(creator)!=1 or group[0]==creator[0]:
 print('STK04_BOT_SECRET_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS');sys.exit(89)
dsns=[]
for envfile in [root/'deploy'/'.env',root/'deploy'/'production.env',root/'deploy'/'gaybbs.env',
 root.parent.parent/'deploy'/'.env',root.parent/'CreateVdobot'/'deploy'/'.env']:
 try:
  if not envfile.is_file():continue
  for line in envfile.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
   if not line or line.lstrip().startswith('#') or '=' not in line:continue
   k,v=line.split('=',1)
   if k.strip() in ('DATABASE_URL','GAYBBS_DATABASE_URL','POSTGRES_URL'):
    value=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    u=urllib.parse.urlparse(value)
    if u.scheme in ('postgres','postgresql') and u.hostname and u.path:
     dsns.append(value)
 except (OSError,UnicodeError):pass
if 'DATABASE_URL' in os.environ:
 value=os.environ['DATABASE_URL'];u=urllib.parse.urlparse(value)
 if u.scheme in ('postgres','postgresql'):dsns.append(value)
dsns=list(dict.fromkeys(dsns))
if len(dsns)!=1:
 print('STK04_DATABASE_URL_MISSING_OR_AMBIGUOUS');sys.exit(84)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gace-stk04-live-') as d:
 envfile=Path(d)/'env'
 envfile.write_text('DATABASE_URL='+dsns[0]+'\nBOT_TOKEN_FILE=/run/secrets/gaybbs_pin_token\nCREATEVDOBOT_TOKEN_FILE=/run/secrets/creator_pin_token\n',encoding='utf-8')
 envfile.chmod(0o600)
 cmd=['podman','run','--rm','--network','host','--user','0','--read-only',
 '--pids-limit','64','--memory','256m','--env-file',str(envfile),
 '--volume',str(group[0])+':/run/secrets/gaybbs_pin_token:ro',
 '--volume',str(creator[0])+':/run/secrets/creator_pin_token:ro',
 image,'node','/app/sticker-topic-pin.mjs']
 result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90,check=False)
 for line in (result.stdout+'\n'+result.stderr).splitlines():
  if line.startswith(('STICKER_PIN_TELEGRAM_ACK=','STICKER_PIN_MESSAGE_ID=','STICKER_PIN_INDEPENDENT_READBACK=','STICKER_PIN_RESULT=','STICKER_PIN_ERROR=')):
   print(line)
 if result.returncode:
  print('STK04_LIVE_PIN_EXIT='+str(result.returncode));sys.exit(85)
 if 'STICKER_PIN_TELEGRAM_ACK=YES' not in result.stdout:
  print('STK04_TELEGRAM_ACK_NOT_PRESENT');sys.exit(86)
 print('STK04_LIVE_PIN_API_ACK=PASS')
